summary: Wave D-1, docs/WAVE_D_FEEDBACK.md F3 (contract 28): in the Electricite biome every territory interior is now crossed by small jagged electric streaks in the live wire's visual language. Procedural, inside ElectricComposite.hlsl only (no texture, no fetch, the graph untouched): one arc slot per cell of a 1.46 u grid turned 24 degrees; per 0.8 s slot (each cell on its own Weyl phase, so nothing flashes globally) a cell holds an arc with a probability set by ElectricTheme.ShaderParams (_PIO_BiomeParams). An arc is 0.3 - 0.8 u long, at a random spot and angle, drifts up to 0.25 u/s, pops in, flickers while its two-level piecewise linear jag (5 + 10 segments, anchored ends, slope-corrected distance) is re-rolled at its own 12 - 20 Hz rate, fades out and re-spawns elsewhere; a few more within about 0.6 u of the rim (wide relief field). Look: the hex lines calm under the glow, a neon halo blended toward the boosted player color (luminance capped below the core, so it never outshines the core even on cyan), and a white-hot core (secondary color pushed halfway to white x 0.82: at most sRGB luma 230 for the four electric colors, below the 235 readability threshold, never feeding the High bloom). No arcs under pending pockets (stripes only) nor across the rim band; the short circuit blacks them out with the territory. Tiers: High density 0.8 (+0.4 near the rim), Medium half, Low a quarter with 2 s slots, 3 Hz jag, no drift, coarse jag only (a few static-ish arcs). Evidence on Build/elec-arcs (human pinned to palette index 0): DevShots 540x960 and 1080x2400 at High, Medium and Low (docs/waveD/shots/elec-arcs/, compare/ sheets against the gate C gallery); 20 fps window-capture sequences at High and Low plus the gate C build (seq_*: frames, sheets, real-time GIFs). Readability: packet vs pearl (luma >= 235, CutDroplets 540x960) Medium 2.84x (gate C 2.74x), High 2.36x (gate C 2.40x); the arcs add no luma >= 235 pixel in the home territory and raise its mean luma by about 1 to 2 %; frame-to-frame swing of the territory mean luma max 0.5 % (gate C build 0.8 %): no strobe, while 87 % of the hot pixels change every frame. Perf (electric, Medium, uncapped, A/B interleaved over 3 rounds, quiet runs only): slope 2.10 -> 2.25 ms/Mpix (+7.4 %, budget +15 %), 1080x1200 avgMs 3.60 -> 3.57 ms. Probe hash 246577239DE179C4 at -fps 30, -fps 144 and in the electric probe. SetupAndCompile PASS (ShaderCheck 12 shaders, 0 failure); EditMode 503 run, 502 pass, 2 skipped, 1 failure that belongs to liq-drop (LiquidComposite fetch count 14 vs 13 in a wave C test; the electric half of that test passes).

api_additions: ElectricTheme (Runtime/Biomes/ElectricTheme.cs): public const float ArcDensity = 0.8f, ArcRimDensity = 0.4f, ArcCoreLevel = 0.82f, ArcGlowLevel = 0.75f; public static Vector4 ArcParams => (ArcDensity, ArcRimDensity, ArcCoreLevel, ArcGlowLevel). ElectricTheme.Create().ShaderParams = ArcParams (was Vector4.zero), published by LiquidRenderer as _PIO_BiomeParams.

ElectricComposite.hlsl: float2 PIOE_Arcs(float2 w, float time, float density, bool low, float pix) (x = core coverage, y = glow, no derivative, usable in a branch) and its helpers uint PIOE_Mix(uint), uint PIOE_HashKey(float2 cell, float key), float PIOE_Byte(uint, uint), float PIOE_Knot4(uint, uint), float PIOE_Knot3(uint, uint).

ElectricComposite.hlsl defines: PIOE_ARC_CELL 1.46, PIOE_ARC_LEN_MIN 0.30, PIOE_ARC_LEN_MAX 0.80, PIOE_ARC_CORE 0.042, PIOE_ARC_GLOW 0.17, PIOE_ARC_CALM 0.5, PIOE_ARC_NEON 1.3, PIOE_ARC_HALO 0.45, PIOE_ARC_WHITE 0.5, PIOE_ARC_PERIOD 0.8, PIOE_ARC_PERIOD_LOW 2.0, PIOE_ARC_DRIFT 0.25, PIOE_ARC_HZ_MIN 12, PIOE_ARC_HZ_MAX 20, PIOE_ARC_HZ_LOW 3, PIOE_ARC_MEDIUM 0.5, PIOE_ARC_LOW 0.25. Invariant: half length max + 1.4 x jag max + glow (0.721 u) < PIOE_ARC_CELL / 2 (0.73 u), the arc center stays inside its cell (jitter margin 0.08 cell >= drift 0.068 cell).
contract_issues: 25.4 Territory (as built, F3): 'interior = neon surface with a slowly flowing hex pattern, crossed by short jagged arcs (0.3 - 0.8 u, white-hot core below sRGB luma 235 in a neon halo of the player color, jag re-rolled at 12 - 20 Hz per arc, drifting, re-spawning every 0.8 s per 1.46 u cell on independent phases, more within about 0.6 u of the rim, none under pending pockets nor across the rim band); Medium half the density, Low a quarter with slow static-ish arcs'. No fetch added: the 12.2 item 4 / 26.3 electric budget (Medium 5 without actors, 6 with) is unchanged.

25.2 BiomeTheme.ShaderParams: the electric theme now uses it (ElectricTheme.ArcParams = density 0.8, rim density 0.4, core level 0.82, glow level 0.75, read by ElectricComposite as _PIO_BiomeParams); the B-2 note 'unused by the electric shaders' is obsolete. All zero turns the arcs off (the composite's fallback when the global is unset).

25.5 readability: the interior arcs follow the existing rule (their cores stay below luma 235, the halo is a capped blend, not an addition), so the chase packet stays the brightest moving thing; measured with the 26.3 rule (human pinned to palette index 0).

open_issues: No test file is owned by this package, so no F3 test was added (see needs). Existing guards cover the shader rules: WaveC_OwnedShaders_NoDerivativeOrImplicitLodSampleInsideDynamicBranches (the new arc branches included), WaveC_Composites_KeepTheirFetchCount (electric 10 sites), WaveC_OwnedGraphsCompileOnEverySubshader (ElectricComposite forward pass compiled for GLES3x and Direct3D 11: PASS), WaveC_ElectricFill_ClampsTheAge_AndDrawsNoEdgeFromIt.

BuildAndroid was not run by this package: liq-drop held perf measurements on the shared machine and a Unity build would have invalidated them. The GLES3x compile of the ElectricComposite forward pass (EditMode test above) passed; the gate's verify -Android should confirm.

Perf: the official three-biome perfslope of Build/elec-arcs never got the shared Logs/perfslope.lock (liq-drop held it for four consecutive runs over about 45 min); this package stopped its queued run before it measured anything. The like-for-like number is the A/B of tools/abperf.ps1 (same probe arguments as perfslope, the gate C build and this build interleaved round by round, under the same lock: docs/waveD/shots/elec-arcs/perf/abperf_electric.log). The electric/liquid ratio check is left to the gate (needs). The 540x600 size is noisy on this shared machine (the gate C build read 1.40 ms in liq-drop's quiet run and 1.56 - 2.24 ms in mine), so the 1080x1200 avgMs (3.60 -> 3.57 ms) is the steadier figure, as contract 26.7 notes. Today's baselines of the gate C build: perfslope electric 2.42 (mine, 14 of 22 runs shared), 2.21 (liq-drop, quiet), 2.36 at gate C.

DevShot takes the human color from the shared PlayerPrefs, which other agents' runs change (it was 2, electric yellow, during this wave). This package set HKCU\Software\PainterIO\Painter IO pio.ColorIndex back to 0 before its gallery, sequence and measurement runs (the gate C 26.3 rule); it was still 0 afterwards.

Contrast of the arcs is lowest on the electric yellow (its neon already has two bright channels and the core may not pass luma 235): the arcs read as pale streaks there, clearly visible but softer than on pink, violet and cyan (yellow territory in every gallery shot).

The arcs animate on _PIO_Time (unscaled session time), like the existing micro arcs and hopping arcs, so they keep crackling during pause and slow motion. Intentional (a living board), but a gate could prefer _PIO_Now for them.
